Dawang Raoming 3 Anime Overview:

Continuing the supernatural urban fantasy narrative, the third season of Dawang Raoming follows the ongoing adventures of Lu Shu, an orphaned teenager possessing unique abilities in a modern world undergoing a mystical awakening. As spiritual energy resurfaces and various organizations compete for power and influence, Lu Shu navigates complex social dynamics while secretly training his supernatural prowess. Alongside his adoptive sister Lu Xiaoyu, he must adapt to unpredictable threats and rival awakened individuals who seek to control the unfolding spiritual phenomenon. The series blends contemporary daily life with supernatural combat, tactical maneuvering, and deadpan humor as the siblings strive to secure their footing in an increasingly dangerous environment.

Japanese Title: 大王饶命 第三季

Douluo Dalu 2: Jueshi Tangmen Anime Overview:

Set ten millennia after the establishment of the legendary Tang Sect, this fantasy donghua follows a new generation of martial artists navigating a shifting world where traditional hidden weapons face obsolescence due to the rise of newly invented soul tool technology. As the once-prominent sect struggles against declining influence, a gifted young newcomer joins the prestigious Shrek Academy. Alongside a fresh roster of companions known as the Shrek Seven Monsters, he seeks to harness his unique abilities, confront hidden threats tied to ancient beasts and forgotten legacies, and strive to restore the historic order to its former prominence amidst escalating conflicts.

Zeri Feisheng Anime Overview:

Set during a turbulent era defined by corrupt governance and supernatural threats, the story follows Xu Ying, a humble snake-catcher living in a world plagued by wandering spirits, rogue deities, and forces descending from the Netherworld. Life in the mortal realm grows increasingly perilous as divine figures abuse their authority and ordinary citizens suffer under relentless oppression. Driven to desperation by the escalating injustice, Xu Ying takes matters into his own hands by striking down a corrupt official and slaying a god. This act of defiance instantly marks him as a criminal in both the mortal and divine domains, forcing him to embark on a desperate journey of survival while pursued across realms by powerful adversaries determined to bring him to justice.

Japanese Title: 择日飞升

A towering, tree-like humanoid leans over an aged keyboard instrument inside a cavernous, root-filled chamber. His enormous head fills the upper right of the vertical image, facing left and downward. Deeply furrowed gray-brown skin resembles weathered bark, with a long hooked nose, a heavy brow, and one glossy brown eye. Fine white hair sprouts across his forehead and cheeks, extending into a wispy beard that hangs toward the keys. Thick, twisted branches rise from his head and merge with the surrounding roots. Dark, rough clothing covers his shoulder, where a round bronze-colored clasp is visible.
At the lower right, a long wooden hand rests over the instrument, with one narrow finger reaching onto its yellowed keys. Tarnished gold panels and dark, layered wood frame the keyboard. The curved instrument fills much of the foreground.
Along the left side, small cloaked, humanoid forms with root-like textures stand beneath sweeping arches. The chamber recedes toward a large circular opening near the lower center, where pale daylight reveals mist and scattered orange foliage. Additional light enters from the upper left, catching the figure’s white hair against the deep green-gray shadows.

A tall, nearly monochromatic image looks upward along a grand staircase inside a decaying, ornate mansion. A lone humanlike figure stands facing the viewer near the center of the stairs. Long, stringy hair frames a gaunt, shadowed face. The figure wears a ragged, dark coat over a long garment, with torn strips hanging around the legs and heavy footwear planted on separate steps.
Bulging black plastic bags cover much of the staircase, growing larger toward the foreground until they fill the bottom of the image. Scattered spoons, forks, and other metallic utensils glint among the bags and across the pale stone steps. Elaborate dark railings rise along both sides, their curling metalwork draped with cobwebs and debris. Above, the stairs divide toward an upper landing crowded with more bags and tangled material.
Decorative wall panels, molding, and plaster ornaments remain visible beneath peeling, stained surfaces. Part of a crystal chandelier hangs at the top edge. Pale overhead light illuminates the upper walls and filters through thick gray haze behind the figure. The bright upper landing contrasts with the deeply shadowed foreground, emphasizing the staircase’s height and the narrow passage through the accumulated clutter.

images.alt:
雪が静かに舞い落ちる冬の夕暮れ、住宅や商店が立ち並ぶ街の道路を、一人の少女が歩いている様子を描いた、アニメ調の縦長のイラスト。

少女は画面中央からやや右寄りに大きく描かれている。黒に近い焦げ茶色の髪は肩に届くほどの長さで、少し乱れた毛先が頬にかかっている。長い前髪の隙間から覗く瞳は琥珀色で、頬は寒さのためかほんのり赤い。首を少し傾け、控えめに口を開いた柔らかな表情を浮かべている。左手をパーカーのポケットに入れ、右手は顔の横まで持ち上げ、人差し指と中指を開いたピースサインを作っている。

服装は、胸元にオレンジ色の図柄と英字がプリントされた灰色のパーカーに、紺色の袖を持つ厚手の上着を重ねたもの。腰には赤茶色のチェック柄のシャツを巻き、ゆったりした茶色のカーゴパンツとスニーカーを合わせている。背中には茶色のリュックを背負い、斜めに掛けたストラップの先には、鮮やかなオレンジ色の四角いケースが下がっている。

背景には、古びた建物が並ぶ細い道路が遠くまで続いている。道路脇には除雪された雪が積み上がり、濡れたアスファルトには大きな水たまりが広がっている。左奥には自動車が一台見え、頭上には無数の電線が複雑に交差している。

遠くの地平線には沈みかけた夕日が輝き、建物や路面を温かな橙色に染めている。一方、空の大部分は冷たい青灰色に包まれ、大小さまざまな雪片が少女の髪や衣服、街並みの前を漂っている。

冬の街の冷たさと夕日のぬくもりが溶け合い、少女の何気ないピースサインが、旅先で撮影した記念写真のような親しみやすさを感じさせる作品となっている。

服装は、胸元にオレンジ色の図柄と英字がプリントされた灰色のパーカーに、紺色の袖を持つ厚手の上着を重ねたもの。腰には赤茶色のチェック柄のシャツを巻き、ゆったりした茶色のカーゴパンツとスニーカーを合わせている。背中には茶色のリュックを背負い、斜めに掛けたストラップの先には、鮮やかなオレンジ色の四角いケースが下がっている。

背景には、古びた建物が並ぶ細い道路が遠くまで続いている。道路脇には除雪された雪が積み上がり、濡れたアスファルトには大きな水たまりが広がっている。左奥には自動車が一台見え、頭上には無数の電線が複雑に交差している。

遠くの地平線には沈みかけた夕日が輝き、建物や路面を温かな橙色に染めている。一方、空の大部分は冷たい青灰色に包まれ、大小さまざまな雪片が少女の髪や衣服、街並みの前を漂っている。

冬の街の冷たさと夕日のぬくもりが溶け合い、少女の何気ないピースサインが、旅先で撮影した記念写真のような親しみやすさを感じさせる作品となっている。
